messages.subject: twitteR and shiny - sending tweets with shiny
parts:
Hi. I've been developing a system where I use twitter as a sort of temporal data store... basically, I define a syntax for data I want to log and use twitter to log it on the go with my phone (why? ... using twitter like this, I don't have to build an interface and database just to save data on the go - it's all there on twitter waiting for me to download it, timestamped and all).

The, I download the most recent tweets and munge the data from there, which then gets published in a shiny app in the form of graphs and information and all that fun business.

I use the 'twitteR' and 'ROAuth' packages to access twitter. It would be great if I could send tweets from the shiny interface as well. I haven't found a way to send a tweet from R yet. I've seen and tried some old stackoverflow code, but it did not seem to work.

Like I said, not so much a shiny question, but any help would do - and I've seen some people talking about twitteR and ROAuth (and streamR, which I hadn't heard of) lately.

Thanks for reading,

Dan
